description: This file implements a service for detecting potential duplicate CRM entities (Contacts, Leads, Accounts) based on various identifying fields such as email, phone, name, and website. It defines a class with methods for normalization and searching for duplicates within the Django ORM context.

classes.name: DuplicateDetector
classes.description: Service class providing static and class methods for duplicate detection among CRM entities.

methods.name: str normalize_phone(phone: str)
methods.description: Removes all non-digit characters from a phone number and returns the last 10 digits for comparison.

methods.name: str normalize_domain(website: str)
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes a domain from a website URL by removing protocols and 'www'.

methods.name: list["Contact"] find_duplicate_contacts( cls, org, email: str | None = None, phone: str | None = None, first_name: str | None = None, last_name: str | None = None, exclude_id=None, )
methods.description: Finds potential duplicate contacts based on email, phone, and name.

methods.name: list["Lead"] find_duplicate_leads( cls, org, email: str | None = None, phone: str | None = None, first_name: str | None = None, last_name: str | None = None, company_name: str | None = None, exclude_id=None, )
methods.description: Finds potential duplicate leads based on email, phone, name, and company.

methods.name: list["Account"] find_duplicate_accounts( cls, org, name: str | None = None, email: str | None = None, website: str | None = None, phone: str | None = None, exclude_id=None, )
methods.description: Finds potential duplicate accounts based on name, email, website, and phone.
